verdict.rationale: SigNoz's docs list its own "exception tracking and error analysis" capability, which is the core of this story, but the evidence is a single docs-index heading with no detail on how errors are handled. missing for 10: documented grouping of errors into issues, stack trace views, release/version tracking, regression detection, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see application errors grouped into issues with stack traces, release tracking, and regression detection

citations.quote: Configure exception tracking and error analysis
